entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Pursuant to the judgment passed by this Court on 18 th May 2023 upholding the conviction of the appellant for offences punishable under Sections 302/376-A IPC and in view of the gravity and the manner in which offences were committed, this Court had issued production warrants of the appellant for today to show cause as to why a sentence of fixed term be not awarded to him in terms of the decision of the Constitution Bench of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the decision reported as (2016) 7 SCC 1 Union of India vs. V.Sriharan.
2.
The appellant has been produced in custody and has been informed about the notice issued to him that this Court proposes to award a sentence of fixed term.
Learned counsel for the appellant seeks some time to take instructions from the appellant to address arguments.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 18:31:17 3.
At request, renotify on 24th May 2023 when the appellant will be produced by the Superintendent, Tihar Jail in custody.
